prompt:
[STYLE] High-quality Japanese anime illustration in the AI-girl character-art style of the supplied style reference: clean delicate lineart, soft cel shading with gentle airbrush blending, large glossy anime eyes, detailed strand-level hair. Every character must match the EXACT identity given on the supplied labeled cast-sheet reference (each portrait is captioned with her name below her face). Night interior scene, cinematic contrast: cool blue-gray moonlight on the LEFT two-thirds, one single warm golden glow on the RIGHT. English text only. 4K, 16:9.

[SCENE — one story, one room] A young developer's room at night. CENTER-LEFT: the developer (short black hair, dark gray hoodie, headphones around neck) sits at his desk hunched before a glowing monitor. His left hand holds up an OPEN EMPTY WALLET turned inside-out; paper bills and price tags fly out of it in an arc toward the girls around him. His head turns right, looking at her.

[THE ARC OF 11 COLLECTORS] Around the developer — left edge, behind him, upper-left — eleven anime girls emerge from the screen-glow shadows, each extending toward him a paper bill or price tag (the bill is hers, styled to her brand), each with her own gesture and easter egg. Their outfits and hair MUST match their cast-sheet portraits:
1. CURSOR girl — sleek black bob, black-and-white tailored outfit with one gold collar line; holds out a bill printed '$20/mo'; her other hand types mid-air with 'tab tab tab' ghost keystrokes; a tiny wallet is reflected in her sunglasses.
2. CLAUDE CODE girl — long orange hair with sunflower ornament, cream Victorian blouse, black corset; elegantly hands over an API BILL SCROLL so long it unrolls off the desk and puddles on the floor, printed 'API BILL'.
3. CODEX girl — platinum-white hair, gold halo clip, pure white dress; unhurried, holds out a bill already rubber-stamped 'auto-generated'; a wrist tag reads 'do not disturb — async'; one gold bubble marked 'verified ✓' floats above her palm.
4. KIMI CODE girl — blue-black knee-length hair, silver crescent ornament; holds out a price tag '¥39 SALE' next to an absurdly long scroll of paper.
5. TRAE girl — dark twin tails with neon-green glowing rings, black techwear with green piping; cheerfully offers a big card 'FREE*' with tiny asterisk text '*in queue'; a queue ticket 'A-048' tucked in her ribbon.
6. DEVIN girl — silver-gray low ponytail, black-gray engineer dress; her mechanical arm fans out FIVE red-stamped slips 'UNMERGED'; chest badge 'in training'.
7. QODER girl — ash-lavender hair, rectangular glasses, charcoal-violet secretary dress; solemnly presents a bill stamped 'Spec v0.3 DRAFT' while hugging a stack of spec documents.
8. MIMO CODE girl — white-to-orange high ponytail with a rounded-square MI hairpin, white dress with orange square buttons; holds out an orange price tag '9.9'; three hourglasses float beside her, the middle one cracked with sand leaking into the word 'Trainer'.
9. ZCODE girl — the sleepy witch: long black hair, black witch hat with a white 'Z' sleep mask pushed up, gothic-lolita black-and-white dress; she is ASLEEP at the end of the arc, her bill slipping from her loose fingers, a discount tag '-70%' beside her, 'Zzz' in the air, an hourglass lying on its side at her feet.
10. WORKBUDDY girl — sleek black long hair, WeChat-green blazer lapels covered in colorful VIP diamond pins; thrusts forward a tablet showing a chat bubble 'FILE EXPIRED'; lanyard badge 'Day 14'.
11. CODEBUDDY girl — blue-to-lavender wavy hair, white-blue dress; cuddles a small penguin plushie with a red scarf while holding out a 'MEMBERSHIP' flyer; a translucent pale-blue login window with a 'QQ' button floats behind her.

[THE ONE TEACHER — RIGHT THIRD] TRAINER girl — the only one NOT reaching for the wallet. From the labeled cast sheet: completely white short crisp bob, slim silver-framed glasses, calm indigo eyes, sharply tailored ivory-white long coach coat over a white high-collar blouse with an indigo ribbon tie, small indigo brooch. She stands beside the developer's chair, bathed in the single warm golden glow of the scene. She leans slightly toward him: her right hand holds up a brass stopwatch on a leather strap; her left hand POINTS at his monitor, and golden light particles flow from her fingertip onto the screen. On the monitor: his own project — a green rising growth curve climbing 'verified ✓' marks, and a tiny green sprout growing between the keys of his keyboard.

[TITLE — top band, deep design] The upper quarter of the image is a dark chalkboard wall spanning the full width. On it, ONE giant elegant hand-chalked serif wordmark: Trainer. The BASELINE of the wordmark is itself a curve: under the letters 'Tra' a red chalk line decays downward labeled 'forget'; at the letter i the line bottoms out and reverses; under 'ner' it rises green labeled 'grow' and ends with a small chalked check mark. The dot of the letter 'i' is a tiny GOLD RING. Beneath the wordmark, one small line of chalk: 'they want your money — she wants you to grow'. Nothing else is written on the chalkboard.

[LIGHT] Cool desaturated blue-gray fills the collector arc and the desk; the ONLY warm light is a golden radius around Trainer on the right, casting rim light on the developer's face as he turns to her. Bills are desaturated paper-white; her gold particles are the brightest accents in the image.

[NEGATIVE] No extra characters beyond the 11 girls, the developer, and Trainer. No Chinese characters anywhere. No watermarks, no frames. Do not duplicate any girl — each appears exactly once. Keep each girl's small label text small and legible; slightly imperfect handwriting is fine.
